strings: When m_c tried to eat, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had to quickly turn to r_c0 and ask for some anti-nausea herbs.

m_c decided to try an old favorite food of {PRONOUN/m_c/inposs}, but {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} ended up not liking it. In fact, its texture and taste made {PRONOUN/m_c/object} feel nauseous, and {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} now {VERB/m_c/lie/lies} in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest, curled up and hoping that this feeling will go away soon.
When m_c is hungry, that hunger manifests as a case of nausea.
m_c isn't able to finish {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} prey, leaving it half eaten and looking like {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} might be sick.
